$comment: The sentences an agent's computer says about itself, read by the web (src/components/agents/agent-computer.tsx) and checked against the apps (NativeAgentComputerSentence in NativeAgentComputerView.swift, NativeAgentComputerHandBackTests.swift). {agent}, {minutes} and {summary} are filled in; everything else is said as written.
asleep: Asleep. It wakes when {agent} starts working.
idleUnknown: Idle. It rests after a few minutes.

controlHere.web: You have control. {agent} waits until you hand back.
controlHere.ios: Your iPhone has control. {agent} waits until you hand back.
controlHere.macos: Your Mac has control. {agent} waits until you hand back.

heldByApp: Your app has control. Hand back there first.
heldByOtherDevice: Another of your devices has control. Hand back there first.
heldByWeb: A browser has control right now.
